current_date: December 2024 (latest revision stated in the 'Status of List' text; consultation 16 December 2024 to 10 January 2025; original list issued 1 April 2023)
current_evidence: The council's Local Validation List page links only 'Local Validation List 2025.pdf', and a web search found no 2026 replacement; the document's revision history ends with the December 2024 amendments (consultation closed 10 January 2025).

issues.detail: The List date 2023-04-01 is the original issue date. The linked 'Local Validation List 2025' was revised in March 2024 (BNG), April 2024 (admin charges) and December 2024 (BNG and LDC invalid charge; consultation to 10 January 2025). The date should be December 2024/January 2025, so the 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' flag is wrong.
issues.evidence: Status of List: 'issued 1 April 2023' ... 'In December 2024 amendments were made to the requirements for Biodiversity Net Gain...' (consultation 16 December 2024 to 10 January 2025)

issues.detail: 9 of the 17 tab_items (the drawing standards and the Thames Basin Heaths/SANG items) come from the superseded 2023 list, not the current 2025 list. The 2023 PDF is still listed in docs_read as a source.

Several local requirements in the 2025 list are missing from tab_items and app_type_rows: Parking Management Plan (often for majors; some changes of use and minors); Phasing Plan (major/strategic developments over 50 dwellings); Delivery and Servicing Management Plan (new dwellings and commercial proposals including changes of use); Demolition Method Statement (demolition prior approvals; significant demolition near sensitive receptors); Pollution Assessment (sites that may be affected by or cause pollution); Severe Weather Management Plan (major and potentially vulnerable development); Site Connectivity Plan (Communications) (major residential and employment development); Telecommunications Report (telecoms applications); Utilities Assessment (foul sewage assessments and all majors).
issues.evidence: Section 2 Supporting Documents List, items 'Parking Management Plan', 'Phasing Plan', 'Delivery and Servicing Management Plan', 'Demolition Method Statement', 'Pollution Assessment', 'Severe Weather Management Plan', 'Site Connectivity Plan', 'Telecommunications Report', 'Utilities Assessment'

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none)'. The list has a dedicated Householder Planning Application Guide (pp. 9-22), and its Quick Summary matrix requires for householder applications a site/block plan, existing and proposed floor plans, elevations and roof plans, and CIL Form 1 ('always'), plus sometimes a Heritage Statement, Habitats Survey, FRA, Tree Survey and Planning Statement.
issues.evidence: Section 1 'Householder Planning Application Guide'; Quick Summary Guide matrix, Householder column

issues.detail: About 45 requirements are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The list's own matrix gives the application types. Examples: Affordable Housing Statement applies to outline AND full schemes with a net gain of 10+ units (Outline is shown as '(none)'); Design and Access Statement applies to major outline and Listed Building Consent; Structural Survey applies to residential prior approvals and listed building works; Marketing Exercise applies to changes of use. Outline, Advertisement, LDC, Prior approval, Discharge of conditions, NMA, Works to trees and S106 modification are all shown as '(none)', but Section 3 'Requirements for Other Application Types' sets out specific requirements for prior approvals (GPDO Parts 2, 3, 4, 6, 11, 16, 20), NMAs, discharge of conditions, protected tree works and S106 modification/discharge. The matrix also gives advert and LDC requirements (e.g. a site plan 'often' for LDCs and CIL Form 1).
issues.evidence: Quick Summary Guide matrix (Householder/Major/Minor/Change of Use/Advert/Listed Building Works/CA-LB Demolition/Lawful Certificate); Section 3

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts belong to different items. Health Impact Assessment's excerpt is the heading of the next item ('...Heritage Statement National requirement') and should read 'major developments'. Flood Risk Assessment's excerpt is from the Site Levels item ('...or when the proposal is on land which is not reasonably level') instead of 'sites over 1 ha and all proposals in flood zones 2 or 3'. Ventilation/Extraction's excerpt is Energy Statement text ('Heating, ventilation and lighting factors Low and zero carbon feasibility report') instead of 'restaurants, pubs, takeaways; plant, machinery, air conditioning, air source heat pumps'. S106 Heads of Terms' excerpt is 'Discharge of a S106 Legal Agreement' instead of 'typically major, case by case'. Schedule of works (listed building)'s excerpt is tree text ('(AIA), Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) and Tree Protection Plan').
issues.evidence: Supporting Documents List triggers: FRA 'sites over 1 hectare... flood zones 2 or 3'; HIA 'Major developments'; Ventilation/Extraction 'Restaurants, pubs, takeaways; plant...'

issues.detail: Most trigger excerpts carry only the heading and 'Local requirement.', with no actual trigger or threshold. Examples: Affordable Housing (should be net gain of 10+ units), Archaeological DBA (Areas of High Archaeological Potential or sites over 0.4 ha), Retail Impact Assessment (over 2,500 sqm gross, or outside Camberley Town Centre), Financial Viability (10+ units below the affordable threshold), Lighting, Noise, Marketing, Contaminated Land, CEMP, Crime Prevention (majors). Others are page-break garble, e.g. CIL 'SURREY HEATH BOROUGH COUNCIL Page 11 of 76 Item CIL Form 1...' and SCI/Structural Survey 'Site Connectivity Plan Communications Statement of Community Involvement (SCI) Structural Survey Emerging policy Surrey Heath Climate Change Action Plan 2021'. The Design and Access Statement excerpt covers only the conservation area 100 sqm case and omits majors and LBC.
issues.evidence: Supporting Documents List 'When Required' column for each item

issues.detail: The tab_items include process text, revision notes and fees rather than requirements: 'In April 2024 this document was updated to include administrative service charges...', 'In December 2024 amendments were made...', 'Type Fee Notes Administrative charge for invalid major application £225...', 'This charge will also apply if an invalid application is withdrawn...', '...Triggered after 6 weeks of inactivity Page 7 of 76 Important:', and the policy citation 'Thames Basin Heaths Special Protection Area Avoidance Strategy SPD, January 2012.'
issues.evidence: Pages 4-7 of the 2025 list (Status of List / administrative service charges)

issues.detail: Three app_type_rows are not separate requirements in the source. 'Tall buildings / Wind microclimate assessment' is only a clause of the LVIA trigger. 'Housing mix / dwelling standards' rests on the fragment 'calculate internal space standards.' 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is a note within the Site/Block Plan item, not a standalone requirement.
issues.evidence: LVIA 'When Required': '...tall buildings'; Site Plan guidance '...public highway, visibility splays, landscaping, car parking'

issues.detail: Drawing-standard items are repeated, including 'Unique drawing number reference' (four times) and the Cross Sections fragment (once from the 2023 list, 'Page 10 of 72', and once from the 2025 list, 'Page 13 of 76'). Mid-sentence page headers have been merged into the text.

summary: Grokbot links the current 'Local Validation List 2025' PDF (last revised December 2024), but dates it to the original April 2023 issue and takes some tab items from the superseded 2023 list. The extraction is poor: householder and other application types are wrongly shown with no local requirements, about nine local requirements are missing, and many triggers are blank, garbled or taken from the wrong item.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
